description.zh: 搜索关键词。任务ID/名称，名称支持模糊搜索。
description.en: The search keyword. You can use the job ID or name as the keyword to search for jobs. If you search for jobs by name, fuzzy match is supported.

description.zh: 分页大小，每页显示条数。默认值为10，最大值为100。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

description.zh:
排序，按CreateTime排序，默认是desc。

- asc：正序
- desc：倒序
description.en:
The sorting order. By default, the query results are sorted by creation time in descending order. Valid values:

- asc

- desc

description.zh:
启动模式。

- 0 - 立即启动
- 1 - 定时启动
description.en:
The start mode of the transcoding job.

- 0: The transcoding job immediately starts.

- 1: The transcoding job starts at the scheduled time.

description.zh:
任务状态。

- 0：未启动

- 1：运行中

- 2：已停止
description.en:
The state of the job.

0: The job is not started. 1: The job is in progress. 2: The job is stopped.

description.zh:
转码任务对应的模版类型。

- normal - 普通
- narrow-band - 窄高
- audio-only - 纯音频
- origin - 原画
description.en:
The type of the template used by the transcoding job.

- normal

- narrow-band

- audio-only

- origin

title.zh: 获取实时媒体转码任务列表
